cast.title: Bird Box Barcelona
cast.overview: After a mysterious force decimates the world’s population, Sebastian must navigate his own survival journey through the desolate streets of Barcelona. As he forms uneasy alliances with other survivors and they try to escape the city, an unexpected and even more sinister threat grows.

cast.title: On Swift Horses
cast.overview: Returning from the Korean War, Lee wants to begin a new life with his wife Muriel in California. But when his charismatic brother Julius arrives, their lives begin to change. Julius’s rebellious streak rubs off on Muriel, who secretly steps into the world of race horse gambling. Here she meets a new lover, a fellow woman looking to break free from her restrictive life. Meanwhile, Julius travels to Las Vegas, where he falls in love with a young man he meets at the card tables.

cast.title: A Panoramic Canvas Called Babylon
cast.overview: The cast and crew discuss the inspiration and motivation behind the original story and development of this epic, 15 years in the making.

cast.title: I Promise You Anarchy
cast.overview: Miguel and Johnny know each other since childhood. They are dedicated to skate and have fun. To earn easy money and continue skating, they sell their own blood to a clandestine contact in a hospital. The activity becomes business until a large transaction is not as they imagined.

cast.title: Otro muerto
cast.overview: Lazaro is a young gravedigger with a strange and unfortunate gift, he can see in people the crosses that announce the date of their imminent death. Inert before the immensity of death, he has learned to cope with his ability by being indifferent. The somber everyday life that Lazaro has submitted himself to accept is violently interrupted when a cross appears on the neck of the love of his life: Isaac. Lazaro faces his destiny; that of being consumed by the fact that he is only a spectator aware of the end of all those he loves.

cast.title: Glamour
cast.overview: It follows two former lovers, who happen to be vampires, as they cross paths for the first time in decades.

cast.title: Babylon
cast.overview: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, tracing the rise and fall of multiple characters in an era of unbridled decadence and depravity during Hollywood's transition from silent films to sound films in the late 1920s.

cast.title: City of Dreams
cast.overview: A Mexican teenager whose dreams of becoming a soccer star are disrupted when his mother dies. He's smuggled across the border with the promise of a better life but is instead sold to a sweatshop in downtown LA.

cast.title: Tigers
cast.original_title: Tigres de noche, arena de día
cast.overview: A story centered on the centuries-old feud between the aristocratic vampire race and their former slaves, the werewolves.

cast.title: ColOZio
cast.overview: In 1994, Mexican presidential candidate Colosio garnered attention for his democratic ideology and anti-corruption stance until he was shot through the head in Tijuana. The wondrous ColOZio, which is partly based on true events, starts three days prior with a prophecy to tripping friends Diego and Gael: save Colosio from death. The duo's dancing in a kaleidoscopic animated, almost 10-minute-long title sequence subsequently sets the tone for a playful, delightfully over-the-top road movie. Expect mythical apparitions, cartoony chases and plenty of drink and drugs.

cast.title: Help Me Make It Through the Night
cast.overview: A family on the brink of a break up: dad is about to throw out mom because of her gambling addiction, the oldest boy's girlfriend is about to leave him because of his epilepsy and the youngest child thinks he has the perfect plan to bring the family back together again.

cast.title: Beautiful Losers
cast.overview: A boy and a girl who have just met transport a corpse on request to the north of Mexico. When the police discover them at a routine check, they are forced to flee. Forced to team up, they will abandon their secrecy and mistrust while trying to assert his only heritage: a dead man who they only know is worth money if they manage to take him to his destination.

cast.title: Video Game Auteur
cast.overview: Video games are an art form in the eyes of Chris Marquez, a youtuber critic who travels to Japan to interview three of the world's leading game designers.

cast.title: Her Private Hell
cast.overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

cast.title: Killing Castro
cast.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

cast.title: Club Kid
cast.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

cast.title: Baton
cast.overview: A soccer player, relentlessly pursues his dream of playing professionally, threatens his relationship with his sister after he is kicked off the team and exiled back to Miami. As they battle over their mother’s legacy, he will stop at nothing to get another chance at soccer glory, even if it means losing the only family he has left.

cast.title: Drama King
cast.overview: Rodrigo Rojas is a telenovela actor anxious to break away from his melodramatic roles. When a prominent film director arrives in Mexico, he jumps at the chance to make it in the movies, despite the humiliating blows to his pride.

cast.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
cast.overview: After a passionate one-night stand, an American backpacker spends an extra night in Mexico City to pursue new romance, only to realize that some things in life are better left alone.

cast.title: Possession
cast.overview: A remake of Andrzej Zulawski's 1981 cult horror. Plot TBA.

cast.title: Cachorro
cast.overview: During his night shift, Alfonso Vera—a seasoned, veteran police officer—has a difficult night working alongside his new partner, Marco Garay, who relentlessly questions him about his personal and professional life. Between the lack of communication with his son—leaving him unsure if the boy is even home—and persistent inquiries regarding a work-related incident that has led to legal trouble, Alfonso is left completely on edge. Meanwhile, Alex Vera—Alfonso’s serious, reserved son, who lost his mother—returns from a date with his girlfriend, Mariana Ruizpalacio, only to find the Ruizpalacio family home partially destroyed.

crew.title: Sharp Wounds
crew.overview: This is a special summer for ten-year-old Valeria, who lives in Mexico City with his family. Valeria is emotionally aware and is rocked by her first romance, the last stretch of childhood, and a forbidden love between her brother and her best friend. A beautiful and sunny coming-of-age film for older primary school children.
